summary: Pole tower with an L-4 cab from 1934 on Copper Mountain, Boundary County, Idaho; named lookouts 1946-1951; listed as gone.

facts.design: Pole tower with an L-4 cab (1934)
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by three sources. None gives a year or method for the removal.

access.note: Hike-in site on Kaniksu National Forest land. The level is inferred from the hike-in listing; no source states an access rule.

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts; no route or distance is given.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four short pages, consistent with each other. The Weebly page only lists the site under Kaniksu National Forest with a link to another lookout page, which was not read. A guessed NHLR URL returned 404, so no NHLR entry was found. The staff names are quoted in evidence only and are left out of the story. The removal year is not in any source, so the event list does not record one. The record's access 'unknown' is set to public by inference from the hike-in note.
